answer: No. The vertex Omega^2 Upsilon^2 is charge neutral and the propagator is purely off-diagonal, so every Wick contraction pairs Omega with Upsilon and is neutral too. The charge of a process operator is therefore fixed by its external legs and is independent of loop order: loops dress an operator without moving it up the charge ladder. The one-sidedness hypothesis is loop-stable in this ambient bookkeeping. This does not supply an infrared regulator or exclude a measure anomaly.
